description: In front of you on the tabletop are a small clear plastic container holding reddish items, a white dustpan, a blue square tile, a yellow spoon, a pink rubber duck, and a red lid. The left hand stays resting near the lower left, while the right hand reaches in from the right, dips into the clear container to grasp one reddish item (right-hand object), lifts it out, moves leftward, and places it into the white dustpan before releasing and withdrawing.
